instruction: Set VLC's default recording folder to /home/user/Documents.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened GNOME Settings, navigated to Default Applications, and changed the default video player from Videos to VLC media player in 9 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open system Settings via Activities search, navigate sidebar menus, use dropdown selectors to change settings
metadata.task_rationale: Tests the agent's ability to find and modify VLC's recording path in preferences, requiring navigation through VLC's Input/Codecs settings panel
metadata.explanation: Task requires opening VLC, navigating to Tools > Preferences > Input/Codecs, and changing the record directory to /home/user/Documents. Evaluator closes VLC to save config, then reads vlcrc to check input-record-path equals /home/user/Documents.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vlc_config) correctly reads ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc from the VM, which is the right config file for VLC settings on Linux
Metric (is_vlc_recordings_folder) correctly parses vlcrc, skips comment lines starting with '#', finds 'input-record-path' key, extracts its value, and compares to expected path

Expected parameter handling is correct: with type='rule', get_rule returns {'recording_file_path': '/home/user/Documents'} directly, and metric accesses rule['recording_file_path'] without incorrect nesting
Postconfig properly kills VLC process before reading config, ensuring VLC flushes its settings to disk
Expected value '/home/user/Documents' exactly matches the instruction requirement
Single instruction requirement (set recording folder) is fully covered by the evaluator
